# The Audacity

An AI-first software studio. Senior judgment on architecture, security and launch readiness, AI acceleration on everything else. We take an idea to a real, deployed product in weeks, not a slide deck or a design mockup.

## What we do

We ship AI-first products to production. Fast, and real enough to launch. The headline offer is the Studio Sprint: a fixed-scope, milestone-priced build that puts a real product in users' hands, with the things that make it real (auth, database, payments where needed, analytics, store or web deployment, CI/CD).

Every build runs on one repeatable stack: one codebase for web and mobile, a managed backend, an AI assistant layer, continuous delivery, and store or web deployment. We sell the pattern, not bespoke chaos.

## The offer (confirmed pricing)

- Studio Sprint: Pilot. One core flow, one platform, deployed to production. 2 to 3 weeks. From EUR 6k to 10k. Fixed milestone.
- Studio Sprint: Launch. Investor-ready MVP with auth, data, analytics and deployment. 4 to 6 weeks. From EUR 15k to 30k. Fixed milestone.
- Build Partner Retainer. Ongoing delivery against a roadmap. From EUR 4k a month. Monthly retainer.
- AI-Readiness and Build Audit. A fixed-scope report you can act on, and the low-commitment first step toward a Sprint. About 1 week. From EUR 1.5k to 3k.

Each package states exactly what is included. Anything outside that scope is a clear, priced change order before we build it.

## Proof

We do not have a wall of client logos yet. We have two AI-first products we designed, built and shipped in-house, which is the harder thing to fake.

- Bloop. An AI events concierge for Bologna, built on the studio's standard spine: one codebase, a managed backend and a conversational AI layer. A product we are building and launching right now. It runs a live conversational concierge over a real catalogue of what is on in the city: you ask in plain language and get a real answer over real data. It proves we ship genuinely novel AI product surfaces to production.
- Washiiba. A complete, production-grade marketplace across mobile and web from a single codebase on a managed backend. It is a build-capability receipt: proof we deliver real software across iOS, Android and web end to end.

## Who this is not for

Teams who want a mockup instead of a product in production, warm bodies to staff-augment instead of a studio that owns delivery, or AI as a box to tick rather than a way to move faster on real engineering.
